name: Coding Standards
description: Seed a set of general coding-standard memories into this workspace's first agent (recalled on demand).
author: SwarmGo

entries.content: Code, comments and identifiers are written in English; user-facing docs may be in the project's language.
Prefer small, single-responsibility functions and files; split large modules into focused units.
Validate and verify changes (build/tests) before reporting success; never claim a fix that wasn't run.
Handle errors explicitly; avoid silent failures and swallow-all catches.
